item.title: Nepal Erupts in Peaceful Protests Demanding Action Against Extremism, Justice and Safety for Minorities in Bangladesh
item.description: Protests that began in Nepal against radical and extremist groups in Bangladesh have spread across several Indian states, with demonstrators demanding justice, safety, and protection for Hindus while urging authorities to act firmly against hate and violence. What started as a wave of demonstrations in Nepal has now resonated across India, reaching Assam, West Bengal, […]
